foreground_english.en: It's just unreal what just happened.

result.text: Valenta, huge congratulations. When you landed here in Shanghai, you didn't even know whether
you'll be able to play this tournament. Now you're standing here as the winner. What are
the emotions?
I mean, I was just so like crying. It's just unreal what just happened. I have no idea
what's happening right now. I'm not in a dream. It's just crazy. I'm just so happy
about my performance this past two weeks. I just want to thank everyone that just put
a break to my career since the beginning. Sharing this annoyed is really tough. There
has to be one loser, but I think there's just two winners today, one family, the one. And
I think for the sport of tennis, this story is just unreal. I wish there could be two winners,
but unfortunately there's only one. And for myself, I'm very happy that it's my, it's
me.
Because you were playing your cousin, how did you separate yourself from those emotions
and just trying to beat the guy on the other side of the net?
It's exactly what you just said. Try to beat the other guy on the other side of the net.
Try to put it on the side that is my cousin. That is the guy that I've been training with
at Intexasanium that I've been wearing up with, in vacation and everything. It was really
tough. It did better job than me in the first set with, I think, with cooperating with
the pressure and everything. He played way better than me. And yeah, just find a way
to return that around and then make the match a little bit myself towards him.
Really bold brand of tennis. Once again, today you came back from a set down. How do you explain
that you just play your most courageous tennis when you're under pressure?
I mean, I feel like when I'm down, this is where I just have no choice, but if I want
to have a chance to win, I just need to bring back my A game. In the first set, I didn't
bring my A game. Arthur was playing better than me, as I said. Then the second set became
a serve ball. I took it on my first chance to break and I think from that it became
the crowd. Started to get really involved. We put on way more of a show that we put, I think,
the first half of the match. At least I'm happy for that for the crowd. And yeah, I mean,
it's just surreal to be with Arthur on this court. And as I said again, if there could be
two winners, I think they'll be better. It can be proud. Congratulations.
Thank you very much.
It's just, it's unreal what just happened.
